## Change

Describe the problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Evidence

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Candidate-first and human-only promotion preserved
- [ ] No private data, prompt, trace, credential, absolute path, or conflict copy included
- [ ] Third-party material and license disclosed
- [ ] Capture completeness labeled L0/L1/L2

Substantive code cannot be merged until the contributor-license process is approved and recorded.
